# Student component templates

These six files are the documented starting point for every challenge project.
Run `python3 scripts/sync_student_component_templates.py` after changing one of
them. The course tests verify that every later challenge contains the same
starting guidance, so a student who begins from a later template receives the
same component file as a student who progresses from Challenge 1.

Normal challenge progression still copies the student team's completed files
into the next Project folder. These templates are used only when a new project
is created directly from a course template.
